blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Less than 24 hours after stunning Alex Eala, Tatiana Prozorova continued her magical run in the Singapore Open. The unseeded but unperturbed Russian delivered yet another dazzling comeback, knocking off Wang Xinyu of China, 3-6, 7-5, 6-4, in their thrilling quarterfinal duel. For the third straight time, the 180th-ranked Prozorova rallied from a set down to win. She pulled off the biggest win of her career on Thursday night, outlasting the third-seeded Eala, 4-6, 7-5, 6-3, in the round of 16.
